title: Chapter 270 Gossip Flying All Over The Sky
content:
Chapter 270 Gossip Flying All Over The Sky

Honglian originally felt a kind of happiness and uneasiness because of her father, who had never had such a kind expression and gentle words to herself, and was indulging in it, but it was suddenly broken by someone's questioning everything.

marriage?

Why? Why marry?

Should have thought of it long ago, shouldn't it?

How could my father, who was known for being ruthless in the past, suddenly behave like this to his insignificant daughter, more than ever before, so amiable and amiable, like a truly loving father.

It turns out that all of these are just trying to use themselves to marry other countries!

But this kind of fate, I should have expected it a long time ago, didn't I?

As a nobleman of the royal family, he has been incomparably dignified since he was a child, and enjoys a life that ordinary people can hardly achieve in a lifetime. The blood flowing in his body tells him that if he wants to have these things, he must pay the price.

If it is a man, they should take on the mission of revitalizing this country and let him continue to be rich and strong. If it is a woman, she must be mentally prepared for this marriage at any time, marrying another country, even if her groom is a man she has never met, he may be an ugly monster, a sick man, or even a pale-haired man. Old man, this is the fate they should face.

The eighteenth bride, Bashiro, has pale hair and red makeup.

The mandarin ducks form a double night in the quilt, and a pear blossom presses the crabapple.

This is not only about the joy of a man marrying a beautiful wife, but also his pride in growing old and strong. But it’s not that there is no way, from another aspect, it tells the sorrow of the newlywed woman!

And which young woman in her twenties and eight years, full of vigor, would be willing to marry an old man who is dying and dying!

"Father, I..."

Honglian raised her beautiful face that was about to drip, the jade beads on both sides slipped from her delicate skin, her eyes were filled with a kind of sadness, she was speechless.

What should she say? Don't want to marry and betray her duty as a royal child?

Not to mention, this is impossible. Let's just say that her father really agreed, and she successfully rejected the marriage.

What about after rejection?

As a princess of South Korea, she betrayed her own country and disregarded the interests of millions of people in South Korea just for her own benefit. This is full of ministers.

South Korea doesn't need a princess against their will, hate, will be inevitable.

All of this, if it really happens, how can Honglian live in Korea happily and without worries like before.

What's more, with the kindness in her heart and her love for South Korea, it is impossible to escape from this kind of matter related to the fate of South Korea, and she can only face difficulties.

"Honglian, I know what you're thinking, but for the sake of Korea and the royal family, I have to need you! What's more, His Majesty the emperor of Yuguo is in his thirties, when he is young, vigorous, diligent and brave! You marry him, It is also a good match, and the Emperor Yu is as good as the empress so far, and will not wrong you!" Han Wang's eyes showed a trace of unbearable, but he quickly wiped it away, and turned to a gentle tone, saying unfeeling words .

Honglian's heart trembled, and infinite sorrow welled up in her heart, even though she knew that her fate was already doomed the moment she finished yelling, and she would not allow her own will to be violated.

But her most respected and beloved father urged her so impatiently that she didn't give her the most needed comfort, which still made her feel sad and painful.

"Yes, Father, Honglian understands, Honglian has no intention of rejecting this marriage!" Nodding slowly, Honglian's eyes are full of lifelessness, her face is expressionless, and there is nothing worse than heartbreak.

However, it seemed that when she thought of it, Honglian ignited a ray of life again, and her eyes became a little agile.

Korea, my father, although he has slowly moved away from me, after arriving in a foreign country, it is even more likely that I will never return in this life.

However, I still have a relative who is waiting for me at that place.

Han Fei.

My elder brother, the closest and most beloved person in my heart, regards him as my most solid support.

At this moment, it seems that he is also in the Yu Kingdom where he is about to marry, where he holds the important position of Minister of Dali Temple.

Now that she is married, it doesn't seem like she is unaccompanied and alone.

For the future, Honglian is full of longing again, life does not seem to be full of despair like that.

...

This world, within a short period of one month, was in turmoil.

All kinds of gossip are flying all over the sky, true and false, false and true. Dazzling people all over the world, it is difficult to distinguish.

However, some news has already been confirmed.

The coalition forces of the nations headed by Yuguo seem to be allied again, and the armies of the six nations are gathering in various parts of the country, fighting hard, and the flames of the war seem to be ignited again.

Among them, Qin State was the most terrified. He had just endured an attack from the Six Nations Allied Forces, and he no longer had the strength to withstand another attack from the Six Nations Allied Forces that had initially consolidated the territory.

The envoys of Qin State and He Anjian are running around the six countries, seeming to be looking for a turning point in the war. At the same time, Qin State is also recruiting troops to prepare for this new round of war.

The reason is that the smoke bombs released by the coalition forces frightened him, because the signal sent by the coalition forces pointed directly at Qin, as if they wanted to wipe out this freak, this monster born for war.

As for the Qi State in the east, from the princes and nobles to the common people, they are still immersed in a prosperous and prosperous world. Countless people lingered in the banquet in the wine shop, gathered together, no matter noble or lowly, talking and laughing wantonly about the war in the east of them, with the appearance of pointing out the country.

It’s just that there seem to be a little different voices among them. Some ministers with their own political opinions and lofty ambitions suggested to King Qi to train soldiers and horses, repair armored soldiers, and wait for an opportunity to win enough for Qi in this new round of vortex. Interests.

However, this suggestion was quickly overwhelmed by the veto of King Qi and other ministers who indulged in enjoyment.

They are indulging in today's extravagant life, living a peaceful and carefree life, for fear that their actions will arouse the hostility of the coalition forces. Pointing the soldiers who were originally pointing at Qin State to Qi State, it will bring accidents to his own Qi State. So how dare you agree with the opinions of those blind people!

Secondly, the marriage between the emperor of Yuguo and the princess of South Korea also attracted the attention of most people in the world.

They faintly saw the birth of a more stable alliance. The two countries, Han and Yu, with their in-law relationship as the hub, will become the most stable alliance in this world under the respective interests of both parties.
